customer_reply:
Hello,

Thanks for contacting us. Here is how to resolve this: Missing notification emails: check Admin > Notifications > Bounce list, verify SPF/DKIM for sender domain, ask customer IT to allowlist notifications@platform. Usually L1 resolvable. If this doesn't fix it, reply with the exact error message or a screenshot and we'll take it to our L2 team.

(Note: we can only act on the support request itself; priority and any billing outcomes are determined under our standard policies.)
